commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Hand off now; /handoff 60 sets when the auto handoff kicks in; also on | off | status | resume

tools.name: handoff_ready
tools.description: Call last in a handoff, once the docs and the handoff file are written. mode "continue": the plugin compacts the conversation with compactInstructions, then sends kickoffPrompt to carry on. mode "end": the session is finishing; kickoffPrompt is put in the prompt box when the next session opens in this project.

rewrites.summary: context added: ["[context-handoff] Context window: 49% used (97.4k of 200.0k); handoff at 50%."]

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)
types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: context-handoff.isAuto, context-handoff.phase, context-handoff.hasFired, context-handoff.pending

./register.ts hooks: session.start, prompt.submit, prompt.compose, tool.describe{tool=mcp__context-handoff__handoff_ready}, tool.call{tool=/"^mcp__context-handoff__handoff_ready$"/}, turn.complete, session.compact, session.end, command.run{command=handoff}

./register.ts calls: $.clock.after, $.clock.now, $.command.register, $.command.run, $.config.set (via setThreshold), $.prompt.fill (via fillSaved, startHandoff), $.prompt.read (via startHandoff), $.prompt.submit, $.session.root, $.session.usage (via reading), $.state.get, $.state.set, $.store.delete (via fillSaved), $.store.get (via fillSaved), $.store.set, $.tool.register, $.ui.status (via showStatus), $.ui.toast
./register.ts state writes: context-handoff.hasFired, context-handoff.isAuto, context-handoff.pending, context-handoff.phase
./register.ts state reads: context-handoff.hasFired, context-handoff.isAuto, context-handoff.pending, context-handoff.phase
